claims: Artemis II is scheduled to launch from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II is currently set for April 1, 2026.
Artemis II involves a 10-day crewed lunar flyby.
The Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft for Artemis II will launch from Florida's Space Coast.
Artemis II's mission type is crewed lunar flyby.
NASA's Mission Control Center in Houston will provide monitoring for Artemis II.
Artemis II will send four astronauts around the Moon before returning to Earth.
Artemis I successfully tested the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft without a crew.
Artemis II follows the Artemis I mission
